content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses pakistan

Stripe-dependent platforms like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle promise simplicity but deliver dependency. They handle payment processing, product delivery, and customer management—until they don’t. For creators in Pakistan, these platforms are inaccessible or unreliable. In contrast, sovereign commerce stacks like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provide self-hosted infrastructure. You own the hosting (Cloudflare Pages), backend logic (Cloudflare Workers), order storage (Supabase), and file delivery (Cloudflare R2). Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. This stack is deployed within 48 hours, configured for your products, and handed over with full ownership. No platform lock-in. No subscriptions. Just infrastructure you control.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe, PayPal, and their dependent platforms exclude countries based on compliance risks, not business viability. Pakistan, along with Nigeria, Zimbabwe, and others, is blocked due to geopolitical factors. These platforms offer no recourse. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. By using crypto payments, you avoid centralized financial systems. NOWPayments verifies transactions on-chain, and Cloudflare Workers automate delivery. Your store operates independently of any single platform. This isn’t a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure designed for regions where conventional tools fail. The Edge Commerce Stack is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and payment rejection are the norm, not the exception.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, but that’s irrelevant if you can’t use it. Local gateways in Pakistan charge 4-6% and lack global reach. Crypto payments via NOWPayments cost 0.5% with no monthly fees. Transactions on BSC, Solana, or TRON cost under $0.10. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys this system for a one-time fee of $197. Compare this to Gumroad’s 10% fee (plus payment processing) or Paddle’s 5% + $0.50. Sovereign stacks eliminate recurring costs. You pay for hosting (free tier on Cloudflare), storage (free tier on R2), and payments (0.5%). The real cost is owning your infrastructure instead of renting it.
Stripe exclusion isn’t a business problem—it’s an infrastructure problem.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe-dependent platforms own your customer data, payment history, and product delivery. If they shut down or block your account, you lose everything. Sovereign stacks invert this. After deployment, COREMERCH has no access to your infrastructure. Your store runs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, with backend logic in Cloudflare Workers. Orders are stored in Supabase, and files are delivered via R2. Automation is handled by webhooks—when NOWPayments confirms a transaction, Workers trigger delivery. This system is yours to modify, scale, or relocate. It’s infrastructure sovereignty, not platform dependency.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in Pakistan and need to sell courses globally, Stripe-dependent platforms are non-starters. Workarounds fail. Local gateways limit your reach. Sovereign commerce stacks are the only permanent solution. The Edge Commerce Stack is ideal for creators selling 5+ products, needing automated delivery, and wanting full ownership. If you’re starting smaller, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys a simpler setup. For builders, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and templates. Choose based on your product volume, technical comfort, and long-term goals. The tradeoff is clear: rent platforms and risk shutdowns, or own infrastructure and build sovereignty.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed and configured for you. After delivery, basic GitHub/Cloudflare management is required. COREMERCH provides 30-day support for any issues.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept?
USDT on BSC, Solana, or TRON are recommended for low fees (under $0.10 per transaction). NOWPayments supports 300+ coins, so you can add more as needed.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually via your crypto wallet. The stack includes a refund template in Cloudflare Workers to simplify the process.
Can I scale this infrastructure?
Yes. The stack is designed for scalability. Supabase handles thousands of orders, and Cloudflare Workers scale automatically with demand.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime. If issues arise, your stack can be reconfigured to use a different payment processor without losing other functionality.
